quality_check.description: A single 9:16 vertical abstract screen-print style sample on bone-white and pale-stone grounds. It uses dense soot-black and muted storm blue-gray flat forms, restrained oxidized teal, and sparse vermilion rupture-like accents. Coarse dry archival grain, slight registration offsets, broken ink edges, bold contours, and thin geometric technical lines are visibly present. The composition remains nonrepresentational rather than depicting a scene, with broad matte light fields and deep graphic ink masses. No characters, readable text, logos, charts, realistic UI, photorealism, glossy CGI, anime styling, watercolor softness, sepia engraving, manuscript ornament, or neon cyberpunk treatment are visible.

prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: screen print. Texture family: dry matte screen-print ink with coarse archival print grain and slight registration wear. Palette: bone white and pale stone grounds, dense soot black, muted storm blue-gray, restrained oxidized teal, with sparse vermilion accents reserved for ruptures, anomalies, and failed assumptions. Line treatment: bold flat silhouettes and crisp screen-printed contours, interrupted by occasional dry-ink breaks; technical elements use thin precise geometric lines that visibly fracture or diverge around unexpected events. Lighting: graphic high-contrast illumination with broad matte light fields and deep ink shadows rather than naturalistic shading. Avoid: no photorealism, no glossy 3D CGI, no anime or manga styling, no painterly watercolor softness, no vintage sepia engraving look, no medieval manuscript ornament, no neon cyberpunk palette, no realistic trading-terminal UI, no readable charts, no text embedded in imagery, no random medium changes between beats. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism.
